text.title: Outpost Palisade
text.body: An isolated timber stockade holds the border bluff against howling raider packs. Rally the defenders, repulse the assault waves, and burn the enemy siege timber.
text.obj.0: Repel all three waves assaulting the palisade
text.msg.1: Torchlight at the north gate! Close the breach and keep the archers behind the line.
text.msg.2: Horns from the west woods—a second pack is rushing the western gate!
text.msg.3: Stone golems and mages from the east! Hold the palisade—this is their last push!
text.msg.4: The eastern wave shatters against the wall. The palisade stands unbroken.
text.win: All three siege waves are broken and Highgate Palisade endures.
text.fail.1: Your hero has fallen inside the palisade.
text.fail.2: Both palisade halls have burned. Highgate Watch is lost.
